title: the search box finds and plays a station

clauses.text: the search box finds and plays a station

steps.do: Open RADIO, press the slash key, type a station name, press Enter on a result.
steps.expect: The stations appear as the last entry of the list and Enter plays one (sound is for a person to judge).
steps.runner_did: Booted the image in QEMU and signed in a scratch account (when run through the runner)
